left.raw_text: - Patient with symptoms of neuropathy during the screening.

right.raw_text: - Patient whose Neurological severity score (NSS) score is ≥ 3.
- Patient whose neurological examination is abnormal and suggestive of neuropathy.

left.raw_text: - Patient presenting a pathology that could cause neuropathy (e.g. diabetes, renal failure, etc.).

right.raw_text: This includes patients with diabetes, renal failure, and other conditions that could cause neuropathy.

left.raw_text: - Patient already participating in a category 1 research study (Jardé law).

right.raw_text: This includes patients who are currently enrolled in another clinical trial.

left.raw_text: - Patient in an exclusion period determined by another study.

right.raw_text: This includes patients who are currently excluded from another clinical trial due to their enrollment in this study.

left.raw_text: - Patient under the protection of justice, under guardianship or under curatorship.

right.raw_text: This includes patients who are legally unable to provide informed consent.

left.raw_text: - Patient refusing to sign the consent form.

right.raw_text: This includes patients who have declined to participate in the study.

left.raw_text: - Patient for which it is impossible to provide information about the study.

right.raw_text: This includes patients who are unable to communicate effectively due to language barriers or cognitive impairment.
This includes patients who are currently pregnant, giving birth, or breastfeeding.
